programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.description: Study how machines, materials and production systems work.
programmes.curriculum: Mathematics, mechanics, materials, production and information technology; later electives and a bachelor thesis.
programmes.practical: At least eight weeks of manufacturing internship are required; timing and recognition must follow the programme rules.

programmes.name: Genomics
programmes.description: Use biology, computing and statistics to understand genomes.
programmes.curriculum: Genetics, molecular biology, programming and analysis of genomic data.
programmes.practical: Curricular internship in university or external facilities, in Italy or abroad.

programmes.name: Social sciences and humanities — North America minor
programmes.description: Explore politics, economies and societies with a North America focus.
programmes.curriculum: Law, economics, history, political science, sociology, languages and quantitative methods.
programmes.practical: Civic engagement and a compulsory third year of international mobility; confirm its placement and extra costs.

programmes.name: Creative Technology
programmes.description: Combine technology, design and human needs to build interactive solutions.
programmes.curriculum: Twelve themed modules combine theory, research, programming, design and teamwork.
programmes.practical: A team project is part of every module; external internship availability is not verified.

programmes.name: Commerce (Honours)
programmes.description: Explore business before choosing one or two specialist majors.
programmes.curriculum: Business core, major courses, options and electives; examples include accounting, finance, marketing and business analytics.
programmes.practical: Co-op and exchange opportunities exist; participation and placement conditions need separate checking.

programmes.name: Graphic Design
programmes.duration: Credit-based degree; consult the study plan
programmes.description: Design visual messages for print, screens and public spaces.
programmes.curriculum: Design principles and history, drawing, studio work, branding, publication, interaction and web design.
programmes.practical: Collaborative professional projects and portfolio development through studios; a guaranteed internship is not established.

routes.name: International qualification — aptitude assessment
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant with a foreign secondary qualification
routes.eligibility: Recognised university entrance qualification, German proof, motivation documents and aptitude assessment. Applicants from non-German-language schools whose native language is not German must attend an interview.
routes.recognition: Obtain a uni-assist VPD assessment. Direct eligibility of a Kazakhstan Grade 11 Attestat is not confirmed; preparatory college and its assessment may be necessary. Extra preparation adds time and costs.
routes.subjects: Prepare mathematics, physics, chemistry and German.

ENGLISH.detail: German proof is required. A separate English-test exemption was not explicitly verified.

tuition.note: EUR 3,000 per semester is the current programme reference. A 2027/28 increase is published centrally; the exact new rate needs confirmation. No annual amount is inferred.

routes.mandatoryFees: Mandatory fees not fully verified; request an itemised schedule for your intake.
routes.living: Living costs not verified; request a separate housing, food, insurance and travel budget.
routes.nextAction: Confirm the chosen intake, diploma equivalence and total costs with admissions before applying.
questions: Confirm diploma recognition, any Studienkolleg requirement and internship timing.
Confirm future tuition, mandatory fees and living costs.

routes.name: Non-EU resident abroad — SAT selection reference
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant with a foreign secondary qualification
routes.eligibility: The May 2026 SAT intake included non-EU applicants living outside Italy. The later Italian TOLC-I rounds were restricted to other applicant categories. This is a past-cycle reference.
routes.recognition: Published rules require a foreign qualification after at least twelve school years. Do not assume an eleven-year Attestat alone qualifies; confirm recognised additional study and document recognition.
routes.subjects: Prepare mathematics, logical reasoning, biology and computing.

SAT.detail: SAT was the first-intake selection test for this applicant category in 2026/27; the threshold and next-cycle rules need review.

IELTS.detail: For the published SAT route, SAT satisfies the B2 English requirement; no separate IELTS result is specified for that step.

ENGLISH.detail: No separate English test is specified for the SAT route; B2 English ability remains required. Future-cycle rules are unconfirmed.

tuition.note: Exact tuition for this applicant category and intake awaits verification.

routes.name: Foreign secondary diploma — international admission
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant with a foreign secondary qualification
routes.eligibility: Apply while preparing a non-French secondary diploma. Academic records, written submissions and an interview if invited form the selection. Choose two eligible regional programmes.
routes.recognition: The route accepts applications for foreign secondary diplomas; Kazakhstan Attestat equivalence and any exception must be confirmed individually.
routes.subjects: Develop writing, source analysis, social-science curiosity and strong English.

IELTS.detail: Attaching an external language score is optional; language ability is assessed through written work and interview.

ENGLISH.detail: No external English-test attachment is required. C1 English is expected for this English-taught option and is assessed in selection; confirm conflicting campus-page wording.

tuition.note: 2026/27 annual undergraduate fee for a household fiscally resident outside the EEA. This is not a confirmed 2027/28 fee.

routes.living: Living costs not verified; request a separate housing, food, insurance and travel budget.

routes.name: Kazakhstan — qualifying NIS Grade 12 diploma
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant with a foreign secondary qualification
routes.eligibility: The Kazakhstan direct-entry route lists NIS Grade 12 with at least three Higher Level subjects graded A, B or C, including advanced/higher-level mathematics. Individual admission review and English proof apply.
routes.recognition: A standard Kazakhstan Grade 11 Attestat without NIS Grade 12 is explicitly not directly admissible. Confirm another recognised qualification or additional preparation; progression is not guaranteed.
routes.subjects: Advanced mathematics is required in the Kazakhstan NIS rule; check the programme-specific subject mapping.

IELTS.detail: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall and at least 5.5 in each section; other listed certificates may be used.

ENGLISH.detail: Kazakhstan has no country-based English exemption; submit an accepted certificate.

tuition.note: 2027/28 annual higher institutional rate for non-EU/EEA students; Creative Technology is in this rate group. Individual exemptions may differ.

routes.mandatoryFees: Mandatory fees not fully verified; request an itemised schedule for your intake.
routes.living: Living costs not verified; request a separate housing, food, insurance and travel budget.
routes.nextAction: Confirm the chosen intake, diploma equivalence and total costs with admissions before applying.

routes.name: International school applicant — direct-entry review
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant with a foreign secondary qualification
routes.eligibility: Meet general international and Commerce-specific requirements. Direct entry is for applicants with fewer than 24 post-secondary credit hours. Admission is competitive, not guaranteed by minimum eligibility.
routes.recognition: Kazakhstan course and diploma equivalence are not settled in this record. Ask admissions for the exact country-specific conversion and prerequisites.
routes.subjects: Confirm senior English and mathematics prerequisites and their Kazakhstan equivalents before choosing school subjects.

IELTS.detail: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each module is one accepted option.

ENGLISH.detail: Provide an approved English test or documented qualifying waiver. Kazakhstan schooling is not a blanket exemption.

tuition.note: Exact tuition for this applicant category and intake awaits verification.

routes.living: Living costs not verified; request a separate housing, food, insurance and travel budget.
routes.nextAction: Confirm the chosen intake, diploma equivalence and total costs with admissions before applying.

routes.name: International first-year — general admission
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant with a foreign secondary qualification
routes.eligibility: Published general international minimum is secondary-school GPA 3.00 on the 4.00 scale, plus English proficiency and required school records. The programme refers to general admission rules.
routes.recognition: ASU evaluates foreign school records. Do not self-convert Kazakhstan marks to a guaranteed admission result; confirm diploma completion and document translation rules.
routes.subjects: Build visual communication and drawing skills; confirm the general school-subject requirements.

SAT.detail: SAT/ACT are optional for admission and may support placement or merit review.

ACT.detail: SAT/ACT are optional for admission and may support placement or merit review.

IELTS.detail: General requirement: IELTS Academic overall 6.0; other accepted evidence is available.

TOEFL.detail: General requirement: before 21 January 2026, iBT 61; on/after that date, overall 3.5 and each section 3.5.

ENGLISH.detail: English proficiency is required through an accepted test, approved study history or qualifying preparation. Waivers are conditional, not automatic.

tuition.note: 2026/27 annual international undergraduate base tuition only; college-specific fees are additional. This is not a 2027/28 quote.

routes.mandatoryFees: 2026/27 schedule separately lists tuition surcharge USD 350, technology fee USD 200, student fees USD 807 and insurance USD 2,765; programme college fees must be checked.
routes.living: ASU 2026/27 estimate: housing and meals USD 18,819, books/materials USD 1,320, travel USD 1,650 and personal expenses USD 2,343. Checked 16 November 2026; separate from tuition.
routes.nextAction: Confirm the chosen intake, diploma equivalence and total costs with admissions before applying.
questions: Confirm Kazakhstan document evaluation, college fees and the selected intake deadline.
Confirm future tuition, mandatory fees and living costs.

awards.name: Émile Boutmy — full tuition tier
awards.benefits: Full tuition exemption only; no living-support package is stated. Award level is decided through selection.
awards.eligibility: First-time non-EU applicant, household not taxed in the EU, admitted to an eligible standard programme; exclusions apply. Selection is merit-based.
awards.application: Select Émile Boutmy in the Financial information section before submitting the admission application and before the scholarship deadline.
awards.renewal: Academic-year validation is required; failure or admission deferral loses the award. Tuition support continues in the third-year abroad. Dual-degree changes can end eligibility.
awards.upfront: Living costs, travel and any remaining fees are not a maintenance package. Confirm upfront payments.

awards.name: Émile Boutmy — partial tuition tier
awards.benefits: EUR 9,500 tuition exemption under the published undergraduate tier; confirm the award notice and remaining fees.
awards.eligibility: First-time non-EU applicant, household not taxed in the EU, admitted to an eligible standard programme; exclusions apply. Selection is merit-based.
awards.application: Select Émile Boutmy in the Financial information section before submitting the admission application and before the scholarship deadline.
awards.renewal: Academic-year validation is required; failure or admission deferral loses the award. Tuition support continues in the third-year abroad. Dual-degree changes can end eligibility.
awards.upfront: Living costs, travel and any remaining fees are not a maintenance package. Confirm upfront payments.

awards.name: New American University — international merit award
awards.benefits: Partial merit support; published 2027/28 first-year tiers range from USD 10,000 to USD 17,500. Amount depends on the university evaluation, English results and campus.
awards.eligibility: Full-time on-campus international students who remain self- or family-funded; full sponsorship cancels eligibility.
awards.application: Eligible admitted applicants are automatically reviewed; verify all admission and merit-document deadlines.
awards.renewal: Up to eight consecutive fall/spring semesters for first-year recipients, subject to the published credit and GPA renewal guide.
awards.upfront: Remaining tuition, fees, housing, insurance, travel and visa expenses still require funding.
